'''Magical Pokémon Journey: One Lone Pikachu''' is the ninth monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]]. It contains the 13th and 14th chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|3}}. As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
==Blurb==
'''''DO AS I DO, NOT AS I SAY'''''

''Meet a young ninja who wants to be like gym leader Koga. He's learning martial arts from his ditto master...who better to teach camouflage and hiding?'' 

''Then, Pikachu tries to pick a flower for Hazel, only to find that everyone in the Pokemon world seems to be gone!''
